subject: Future Tech
title: Carbon Nanotube Processors
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Carbon Nanotube Processors.

buildup.text: Nanotube transistors switch faster because electrons move through them with near-zero resistance—ballistic transport.

discovery.text: MIT built a 16-bit carbon nanotube processor in 2019 that ran real programs.

twist.text: Aligning billions of nanotubes precisely is nightmarishly hard.

climax.text: New techniques sort metallic from semiconducting nanotubes with 99.99% purity.

punchline.text: Carbon after silicon. The next chapter of computing is nanoscale.

quiz.question: What advantage do carbon nanotube transistors have over silicon?
options: Faster switching with lower power use
